# Mountain photograph fixture

`mountain.jpg` is a Wikimedia-generated 500px thumbnail of **Himalayas, Ama Dablam, Nepal**, by **Vyacheslav Argenberg**, used as an offline image-format/provenance test sample. It is a real photograph, not a generated placeholder.

- Original description: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Himalayas,_Ama_Dablam,_Nepal.jpg
- Original image: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/2/29/Himalayas%2C_Ama_Dablam%2C_Nepal.jpg
- Downloaded thumbnail: https://thumb.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/29/Himalayas%2C_Ama_Dablam%2C_Nepal.jpg/500px-Himalayas%2C_Ama_Dablam%2C_Nepal.jpg
- Source-reported license: **Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)** — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ ; legal code: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode
- Changes: Wikimedia thumbnail resize; no further image changes in this repository.
- Retrieved: 2026-10-28. The live Imageinfo response named the author and license above and `AttributionRequired: true`.

Retain this attribution and license link with the fixture. A successful format test is not a legal opinion, nor acceptance of its suitability for unrelated commercial/promotional uses. The source's own per-file metadata and reuse guidance remain authoritative evidence for review.
